replication.target_description: Au and Feldman, Problem 11 part 2, final post-exclusion sample; preference for low versus high risk when below a specific goal, one-sample proportion/binomial test, Table 9 p. 41. notes: Replication title and authors verified against assigned reference using the primary OSF preprint. Values are from the final sample, not supplementary full-sample analysis. Authors support the directional hypothesis while describing the effect magnitudes as inconsistent with and larger than the original. Original statistics quoted or recalculated by the replication authors were not substituted for unavailable original primary text.
